fusions.name: Lockjaw
fusions.desc: A bite that deals 13 damage, stuns the target for 1.4 seconds and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Left in the Trap
fusions.desc: Costs 5% of your maximum health. Drops your tail where you stand; its thrashing deals 8 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, with a 40% chance of [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Everything Holds Still
fusions.desc: Holds every creature within 3 tiles in place for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: The Door Swings Shut
fusions.desc: Each time you afflict something, your next strike has 15% more critical hit chance. Once every 8 seconds.
